items.a: Yes. AGPL-3.0-licensed, self-hosted, no paid tier. The only thing you pay for is your own server (or run it on a Raspberry Pi).

Bambu Lab X1 (X1, X1C, X1E), H2 (H2D, H2D Pro, H2C, H2S), P1 (P1P, P1S), P2 (P2S), A1 (A1, A1 mini), A2 (A2L) and X2 (X2D), using local MQTT and file transfer with Developer Mode enabled. AMS Lite works on both A1 and A1 mini; both also support an external spool. Individual camera, AMS, drying and calibration functions depend on the connected hardware and firmware.

items.q: Do I need to expose it to the internet?
items.a: No. The web UI runs on your local network. The Telegram bot reaches Telegram's API outbound - no inbound port required.
Not any more. BamDude forked from Bambuddy 2.2.2 and the two have diverged too far for a one-time import; start with an empty data directory and re-add your printers and spools.

Local by default. BamDude talks to your printers over your LAN in Developer Mode. Out of the box it makes three outbound calls, each with its own switch: the BamDude update check (GitHub), the printer firmware check (Bambu Lab) and anonymous telemetry. Any other cloud service is used only if you set it up: Bambu Cloud and MakerWorld, OrcaSlicer Cloud, OrcaSlicer profiles from GitHub when you import presets, OctoEverywhere AI failure detection, Git backup to GitHub or GitLab, notifications through Telegram, Discord, Pushover, ntfy.sh, Bark, Notify! or CallMeBot, a cloud identity provider for SSO, BamDude Cloud, and a bug report you send. Obico failure detection runs on your own server.

Yes, two ways. SQLite is the default; set DATABASE_URL=embedded and BamDude runs a PostgreSQL 18 it ships with itself, or point DATABASE_URL at your own server. Switching imports your existing database automatically.

items.q: Do I need Telegram or e-mail to see what happened?
items.a: No. The Bell in the app holds a per-user inbox that fills whether or not any external channel is configured, so an alarm about hardware has somewhere to land from the first minute. External channels are for reaching you when you are not looking at the farm.

items.q: Will my Telegram chat get spammed?
items.a: You configure per-chat notification settings, quiet hours, and event types. Defaults are conservative.
